requirements.title: Rider account
requirements.description: Riders shall register an account with a mobile number.

requirements.title: Bicycle unlock
requirements.description: Riders shall unlock an available bicycle by scanning its QR code.

requirements.title: Ride timer
requirements.description: The system shall record the start and end time of each ride.

requirements.title: Trip charge
requirements.description: Riders shall pay a per-minute charge for a completed ride.

requirements.title: Dock return
requirements.description: Riders shall return bicycles to an available station dock.

requirements.title: Damage report
requirements.description: Riders shall report a damaged bicycle through the app.

requirements.title: Station map
requirements.description: Riders shall view nearby stations and available bicycles on a map.

requirements.title: Day pass
requirements.description: Riders shall purchase a day pass for unlimited short rides.

requirements.title: Object intake
requirements.description: Registrars shall create an intake record for each acquired object.

requirements.title: Ownership history
requirements.description: Curators shall record the ownership history of an object.

requirements.title: Object photographs
requirements.description: Photographers shall attach images to an object record.

requirements.title: Condition assessment
requirements.description: Conservators shall record an object's condition before display or loan.

requirements.title: Conservation treatment
requirements.description: Conservators shall log treatment work performed on an object.

requirements.title: Storage location
requirements.description: Staff shall track each object's storage room and shelf.

requirements.title: Object movement
requirements.description: Staff shall record transfers of objects between museum locations.

requirements.title: Exhibition assignment
requirements.description: Curators shall assign objects to scheduled exhibitions.

requirements.title: Gallery label
requirements.description: Curators shall publish a descriptive label for each displayed object.

requirements.title: External loan
requirements.description: Managers shall approve loans of objects to other institutions.

requirements.title: Insurance value
requirements.description: Finance staff shall record the insured value of loaned objects.

requirements.title: Audio guide
requirements.description: Visitors shall play an audio description for selected gallery objects.

requirements.title: Public collection search
requirements.description: Visitors shall search published object records by creator or era.

requirements.title: Staff permissions
requirements.description: Administrators shall grant registrar, curator, conservator, and finance roles.

requirements.title: Record audit
requirements.description: The system shall record who changed an object record and when.

requirements.title: Collection export
requirements.description: Registrars shall export monthly acquisition records as CSV.

requirements.title: Researcher profile
requirements.description: Researchers shall maintain a profile of affiliation and contact details.

requirements.title: Project registration
requirements.description: Principal investigators shall register a research project and its objectives.

requirements.title: Team membership
requirements.description: Investigators shall assign researchers to a project team.

requirements.title: Funding proposal
requirements.description: Investigators shall submit a funding proposal for a research project.

requirements.title: Proposal peer review
requirements.description: Reviewers shall score funding proposals against published criteria.

requirements.title: Award approval
requirements.description: The grants office shall approve funding awards after review.

requirements.title: Project budget
requirements.description: Investigators shall allocate an approved award across budget categories.

requirements.title: Expense claim
requirements.description: Researchers shall submit receipts for project expenses.

requirements.title: Equipment purchase
requirements.description: Procurement staff shall approve research equipment purchases.

requirements.title: Equipment inventory
requirements.description: Lab managers shall track university-owned research equipment.

requirements.title: Equipment booking
requirements.description: Researchers shall reserve an available laboratory instrument time slot.

requirements.title: Instrument servicing
requirements.description: Technicians shall log maintenance of laboratory instruments.

requirements.title: Lab safety training
requirements.description: Researchers shall complete required lab safety training before access.

requirements.title: Lab access
requirements.description: Lab managers shall approve researchers' access to restricted laboratories.

requirements.title: Sample registry
requirements.description: Researchers shall register collected research samples and their identifiers.

requirements.title: Sample storage
requirements.description: Technicians shall record sample freezer and shelf locations.

requirements.title: Participant consent
requirements.description: Researchers shall store signed consent records for human participants.

requirements.title: Ethics approval
requirements.description: The ethics board shall approve human-subjects study protocols before recruitment.

requirements.title: Participant recruitment
requirements.description: Researchers shall record recruitment of participants into approved studies.

requirements.title: Study visit
requirements.description: Coordinators shall schedule participant study visits.

requirements.title: Survey response
requirements.description: Participants shall submit study survey responses online.

requirements.title: Research dataset
requirements.description: Researchers shall upload project datasets to a controlled repository.

requirements.title: Data sharing
requirements.description: Project owners shall approve external access to controlled datasets.

requirements.title: Data retention
requirements.description: The repository shall delete project data after the retention period ends.

requirements.title: Analysis notebook
requirements.description: Researchers shall attach analysis notebooks to a project.

requirements.title: Publication record
requirements.description: Researchers shall record published papers arising from a project.

requirements.title: Publication embargo
requirements.description: The repository shall delay public release of a paper until its embargo ends.

requirements.title: Funder report
requirements.description: Investigators shall submit quarterly progress reports to funders.

requirements.title: Project closure
requirements.description: The grants office shall close a project after final reporting and reconciliation.

requirements.title: Change log
requirements.description: The system shall record who changed a research record and when.

requirements.title: Research permissions
requirements.description: Administrators shall grant investigator, reviewer, finance, and lab-manager roles.

requirements.title: Portfolio export
requirements.description: The grants office shall export project and award summaries as CSV.
